mapper.sql: id, resume_version_id, user_id, storage_ref, content_hash, size_bytes, font_name, status, failure_reason, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resume_export_record WHERE resume_version_id = #{versionId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT e.resume_version_id, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded_count, MAX(CASE WHEN e.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN e.created_at END) AS last_succeeded_at FROM resume_export_record e JOIN resume_version v ON v.id = e.resume_version_id WHERE v.resume_id = #{resumeId} AND e.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY e.resume_version_id
